observations: Photos show large stacks of wooden block-style pallets, used/weathered condition.
Visible ink stamps on block ends: 'IN-008 HT', 'PG5', 'DIN', '09/23', '344', '100' etc.
Boards show surface wear, some darkened/weathered wood, nail heads visible.
Stacking hides the condition of pallets in the middle and bottom of each pile.
No EPAL or EUR logo/brand stamp is visible in any photo, only IPPC-style heat-treatment stamps (HT).

claims.claim: These are 'Euro pallets', standardized wooden pallets widely used for shipping and storage in Europe.
claims.evidence: Photos show only IPPC-style heat-treatment stamps (HT, IN-008); no EPAL/EUR certification logo or stamped dimensions are visible to confirm true Euro-pallet standard.

claims.claim: Widely used for shipping and storage in Europe (general background claim).
claims.evidence: This is a general market statement, not a verifiable fact about the specific pallets photographed.

risks.risk: Pallets hidden inside the stack may have cracked boards, missing blocks, or rot not visible from outside.
risks.proof: Individual photos of each pallet's top and bottom deck, pulled from the stack.
risks.if_unproven: priced as average/used condition with possible defects, not as inspected-good

risks.risk: Dimensions may not match true Euro pallet standard (1200x800mm) despite the seller's label.
risks.proof: A photo of a tape measure against the pallet's length and width.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic used wooden pallet, not certified Euro pallet

risks.risk: Stamps shown (HT, IN-008) indicate heat-treatment/phytosanitary compliance only, not EPAL licensing or load rating.
risks.proof: A clear photo of an EPAL/EUR brand stamp if one exists on any pallet in the lot.

risks.risk: Unclear whether price is per single pallet or for the whole stack/batch shown.
risks.proof: Seller statement or photo caption clarifying unit of sale and quantity.
risks.if_unproven: priced per single pallet, worst case

risks.risk: Wood moisture/rot not visible due to lighting and stacking in photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of board undersides and any discoloration or soft spots.

proof_requests: Photo of a single pallet pulled out of the stack, showing full top and bottom deck.
Close-up of any EPAL/EUR certification stamp, if present.
Tape measure photo showing length and width of one pallet.
Clarification on whether price is per pallet or per batch, and batch size.
response.reason: The items are identifiable by type as used wooden block pallets; the seller's 'Euro pallet' claim is unverified since no EPAL/EUR stamp is visible, so the lot is priced at worst case as generic used pallets pending further proof.
